info.headline: Flood Warning for Bremer River, Bremer River at Wanstead Rd and Bremer River at Langhorne Ck (Upstream)
info.description:
No further flooding is expected along the Bremer River.
The Bremer River at Wanstead Road peaked at 3.85 m around 12:30 pm Tuesday 25 August, with minor flooding. The river is currently at 2.70 m and falling, below the minor flood level. The Bremer River at Wanstead Road is expected to remain below the minor flood level (3.10 m).
The Bremer River at Langhorne Creek (Upstream) peaked at 4.82 m around 08:00 pm Tuesday 25 August, with minor flooding. The river is currently at 4.36 m and falling, below the minor flood level. The Bremer River at Langhorne Creek (Upstream) is expected to remain below the minor flood level (4.80 m).
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.sa.gov.au/incidents-and-warnings/incidents-and-warnings-map/.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
